## What We Do

Shaibya Solutions is a full-stack digital product, software engineering, and automation agency headquartered in Nagpur, India. We partner with ambitious startups, growing SMBs, and industrial enterprises to eliminate manual bottlenecks, build modern web/mobile applications, secure IT environments, and expand digital visibility.

### Service 1: Custom Software & Business Automation
- URL: https://www.shaibyasolutions.com/services/software-solutions
- Capabilities:
  - Custom web and desktop application development using Next.js, React, Node.js, and Python.
  - End-to-end workflow automation (Zapier, Make, n8n, custom event-driven webhooks).
  - OCR document parsing (bills, invoices, weight slips, medical certificates) and ERP/CRM syncing.
  - Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, relational database design with PostgreSQL/Supabase, and Row-Level Security (RLS).
  - Legacy system modernisation and API bridging.

### Service 2: Digital Marketing & B2B Growth
- URL: https://www.shaibyasolutions.com/services/digital-marketing
- Capabilities:
  - Technical and on-page SEO: Core Web Vitals optimization, semantic schema markup (JSON-LD), structured content graphs.
  - Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization for regional leadership.
  - B2B lead generation funnels, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and high-intent landing page engineering.
  - Performance marketing across Meta, Google Ads, and LinkedIn.

### Service 3: Application & Cloud Security (Cybersecurity)
- URL: https://www.shaibyasolutions.com/services/cybersecurity
- Capabilities:
  - Web and mobile application penetration testing (OWASP Top 10 compliance).
  - Cloud infrastructure audit (AWS, GCP, Supabase, Vercel) and posture hardening.
  - Source code security reviews, dependency vulnerability auditing, and secrets detection.
  - Incident response readiness, automated backups, and data encryption policies.

### Service 4: 3D Visualisation & Architectural Animation
- URL: https://www.shaibyasolutions.com/services/3d-modelling-animations
- Capabilities:
  - Photorealistic architectural renders (exteriors, interiors, landscaping).
  - 3D walkthrough video production for real estate developers and infrastructure contractors.
  - Industrial and hardware product animation for marketing and investor pitches.
  - Interactive WebGL and Three.js 3D spatial models directly in browser applications.

## Project Case Studies & Measurable Outcomes

### 1. VIMS Hospital (Healthcare)
- URL: https://www.shaibyasolutions.com/portfolio
- Problem: Outdated digital footprint, patients unable to discover specialist doctors or schedule appointments online, poor local organic search presence.
- Solution: Developed a modern healthcare portal with fast doctor directory search, specialty department categorization, direct appointment requests, and comprehensive local SEO schema.
- Results: 2.5× increase in digital patient inquiries within 6 months; organic Google search rank moved from #50 to #13 for competitive regional healthcare terms; 99.9% uptime.

### 2. Revolution Fitness (Fitness & Gym Management)
- URL: https://www.shaibyasolutions.com/portfolio
- Problem: Member churn caused by manual fee collection, spreadsheet-based attendance, and lack of member self-service.
- Solution: Engineered an integrated gym management platform with WhatsApp automated renewal alerts, payment gateway integration, and attendance tracking.
- Results: Membership grew from 120 to 350+ active members in 90 days; 30% direct revenue increase from timely automated renewals; staff administration overhead reduced by 60%.

### 3. CoalTrack AI (Heavy Industry & Logistics)
- URL: https://www.shaibyasolutions.com/portfolio
- Problem: Paper-heavy manual entry of weightbridge slips and transport challans causing shipping delays, human error in billing, and disputes.
- Solution: Built an automated OCR data extraction pipeline with FastAPI and OpenCV that scans paper manifests, verifies vehicle weights against purchase orders, and updates the ERP in under 3 seconds.
- Results: 95% faster billing pipeline; processing 500+ daily coal shipments with 75% fewer manual billing operators; zero data transcription discrepancies.

### 4. MG Infrastructure (Infrastructure & Construction)
- URL: https://www.shaibyasolutions.com/portfolio
- Problem: High-value government and commercial tenders required a verifiable, interactive track record of heavy infrastructure projects.
- Solution: Built a high-performance interactive portfolio with 3D project models, drone cinematography showcases, and structured project specifications.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What industries does Shaibya Solutions specialize in?
We build tailored software and growth systems for Healthcare, Fitness & Gyms, Heavy Industry & Distribution (Coal, Steel, Logistics), Real Estate & Construction, Professional Services, and E-commerce.

### Where is Shaibya Solutions based?
Our engineering studio is located in Ramdaspeth, Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. We operate with clients across India, North America, the Middle East, and Europe.

### How does Shaibya Solutions approach a new project?
Our process follows 5 structured stages:
1. Discovery (Week 1): 30-minute direct WhatsApp/video consultation to understand your business objectives and eliminate assumptions.
2. Architecture & Design (Weeks 1-2): System architecture diagram, UX wireframes, database schemas, and milestone roadmaps.
3. Rapid Development (Weeks 2-6): Modular development in sprints with continuous preview staging and automated testing.
4. Launch & Hardening: Performance testing, security reviews, SEO verification, and DNS cutover.
5. Growth & Support: Continuous monitoring, automated backups, feature scaling, and SEO rank tracking.
